concepts.name: Free cash flow economics
current_consumers: legacy Valuation, Summary and Investment Case workbook outputs
Latest Quarter QA and trend signals
normalized package and frozen-shell formula consumers

parallel_owners.authority_limit: Current production derives the base CFO-less-capex series and valuation consumers; it is not a unified definition authority for every FCF variant.
Compatibility extraction, writer presentation and QA retain company-adjusted FCF separately from CFO less capex.
The normalized contract versions CFO-less-capex fields and source-backed capital-return inputs, but it has not replaced all production consumers.

concepts.allowed_extension_point: First identify the exact FCF definition and output surface, then change the owning executable formula/source contract and every compatible consumer through change:free-cash-flow-definition@1.
prohibited_owners: sector pack as an invented universal FCF owner
company-adjusted FCF silently substituted for CFO less capex
concepts.notes: No unified canonical owner exists across active production and the normalized transition. CFO less capex, issuer/company-adjusted FCF, FCFF proxies, yields and capital-return coverage are definition-sensitive variants or consumers. This entry is descriptive routing metadata; executable formula and source contracts remain authority. General source-native longitudinal ownership is not yet wired.

concepts.name: Net debt economics
current_consumers: legacy Valuation, leverage and Investment Case workbook outputs
Debt Detail and Leverage/Liquidity transition projections
normalized package and frozen-shell formula consumers

parallel_owners.authority_limit: Current production selects core debt and cash, derives net debt and consumes it in leverage and valuation.
Compatibility analytics, writer bridges and QA replay debt-minus-cash and preserve basis caveats.
The normalized/debt contracts type source-backed instruments, core debt, cash, restricted cash, leases and formula variants, but are not the universal production owner.

concepts.allowed_extension_point: First identify the exact debt/cash basis and output surface, then change the owning executable debt/formula contract and every compatible consumer through change:net-debt-definition@1.
prohibited_owners: Debt Detail instrument rows treated as the summary definition
restricted cash or operating leases silently included or excluded
concepts.notes: No unified canonical owner exists across active production and the normalized transition. Base core-debt-less-unrestricted-cash, lease-adjusted net debt, securities/net-cash variants, gross debt, revolver and leverage inputs remain distinct. Debt Detail is source-backed instrument detail, not the net-debt summary owner. This entry is descriptive routing metadata; executable contracts remain authority. General source-native longitudinal ownership is not yet wired.
